{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column for thousands separators
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for the presence of commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"\nDoes 'revenue' contain commas? {has_commas}")

# Preview the data types
print("\nData types:")
print(df.dtypes)"}
